item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossless)】FLAC - Florrie - Sampler (2016)
item.description:
An album sampler of another version of the debut studio album by British singer songwriter Florrie, intended to be released in 2016 with "Real Love" as its lead single. This was made after the original concept, allegedly titled Trouble in the Making (which was promoted by singles "Little White Lies", "Too Young to Remember", "Live a Little" and the Sirens EP) was scrapped in 2015. It surfaced online sometime in late 2016. It was rumoured that this version of the album was titled Florrie, but there was no official confirmation.

Tracklist:

  2. Get You Good
  3. Hungry Like a Wolf
